answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming at the gate. To claim one work slot, an agent burns a 40-unit deposit and gets an onyx badge that cannot be transferred. The slot pool is an orchard: each tree bears one fruit per epoch, and only a badge-holder may pick it. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities must forge 100 badges at 40 units each, spending 4,000 units before earning anything. The honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the harvest.
